# `tests/test_pipeline.py`

[As built](../../README.md) › `test_pipeline.py`

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Tests for the pipeline's core abstractions: the ledger tracking rework rounds, findings and verdicts, scout and review merging, spec drift detection, unit delivery verification, and invariants around protected paths, budget limits, and loop stopping conditions.

10,437 lines, a test.
